programme.scope_statement: Compiles accepted cross-PR DAP reliability-programme decisions into linked contract invariants, per-decision dispositions, and this deterministic stable index. Adds no product, CI-routing, support, release, or validator behavior.

index_law: stable_semantic_id equals DAPREL-<issue> and is unique
mutable GitHub state such as open/closed, labels, PR numbers, checks, or SHAs is forbidden anywhere in this document
controllers and fan-ins carry behavioural authority summaries but are never builder leaves
each concrete decision carries exactly one disposition from disposition_vocabulary
covered_invariants reference existing compiled_invariants of any family view
hard_dependency_issues are integers referencing distinct decisions of the programme

family_views.title: Lifecycle, generation, broker, and command authority

compiled_invariants.statement: exactly one typed lifecycle/request-admission authority exists; requests failing admission never reach backend action
session and suspension generations thread through retained state and async producers; stale-generation references are rejected
perl5db reads and mutations serialize through the one typed broker; a submitted write is not an acknowledgement
direct perl5db writes stay removed/quarantined under sole-writer recurrence enforcement
execution control and cancellation correlate with lifecycle transitions and resolve to one request-scoped operation
terminal outcomes emit at most one terminal event per generation; repeated terminate is idempotent

family_views.first_falsifier: a second lifecycle/generation/command authority being accepted anywhere in the adapter
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: Implementation and query/mutation/control routing behavior owned by #8691/#8703/#8564/#8581/#8591-child controllers. This compilation adds no readiness, probes, or validation commands.

family_views.title: Launch, path, source identity, and source geometry

compiled_invariants.statement: launch mode is always explicit: workspace-bound or user-owned unbounded; implicit None modes do not exist
the selected launch authority governs every filesystem/path-reading surface including restart and loaded-source
spawns project through one validated launch plan
client paths/lines/columns normalize through session-bound conversion with dirty-source currentness
canonical newline/LF geometry and BOM relations precede any line-index consumption

family_views.first_falsifier: any surface reading program/source/breakpoint/goto/loaded-source/restart paths outside the selected launch authority
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: Position-family controllers own storage semantics; this view owns only their DAP-facing binding.

family_views.title: Breakpoint truth

compiled_invariants.statement: verified status requires exact engine acknowledgement
replacement/removal/idempotence are engine-backed with generation-safe changed events
desired breakpoint sets reapply across launch, configurationDone, and restart without stale verification
stops attribute to exact installed breakpoints and the implicit entry stop is classified
runtime-loaded module breakpoints traverse pending->loaded->installed->changed-event->exact hit
optional breakpoint families stay capability-false until engine-backed runtime proof exists

family_views.first_falsifier: generic success or UI presence standing in for engine-confirmed install/hit evidence
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: No external controller statement applies: the INV-BP invariants are owned inside this family by the breakpoint nodes compiled here.

family_views.title: Inspection, values, and mutation

compiled_invariants.statement: variable identities come from the opaque single-context registry bound to session/suspension generations
retained inspection state is stop-owned, bounded, and mutation-aware
only the exact current executable frame and its real scopes are exposed
inspected values form an immutable graph preserving runtime referent identity with exact paging/counts
evaluateName and package/global access exist only where addressability/frame-package identity is proven
Watch/hover evaluate purely over snapshots; side effects only via the explicit trusted REPL boundary
scalar mutations use canonical target/value/operation/outcome contracts, acknowledged transactions, and atomic promotion while capabilities stay false until proved

family_views.first_falsifier: fabricated/unframed/stale inspection success or unacknowledged mutation reporting success
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: Inspection identity subcontrollers remain integrated under #2301.

family_views.title: Capability and protocol truth

compiled_invariants.statement: advertised initialize capabilities derive from accepted backend-evidence intersection; unknowns stay conservative
every capability row carries frontend/backend/mode/prerequisite/proof owners
advertised true/false sets bind to same-session public behavior on the exact binary
standard methods behave with standard semantics (goto targets, stepIn targeting, exception proof from real suspensions) or stay false
secondary/optional capabilities stay false until exact semantics are proven
production request/event/capability inventories derive from executable syntax and bind to candidate receipts against drift

family_views.first_falsifier: protocol-inventory claims sourced from prose or stale receipts instead of executable/current evidence
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: #10982 owns the static validator command; #10558 owns DAG/consumer semantics. Range anomalies are recorded in scope_corrections.

family_views.title: Transport, peer, package, and backend convergence

compiled_invariants.statement: editor transport is stdio-only canonical; ambient listeners retire with zero-listener proof
external peers authenticate with CSPRNG-minted tokens; no unauthenticated listen paths
peer/stdio event buffering stays bounded with explicit slow-consumer failure
experimental external peers (ptkdb) stay behind validated experimental claim boundaries
packaging feature catalogs sync vendored snapshots under drift enforcement
backend-neutral convergence lands as harness/shadow work; production traffic switches only after full supported-core parity and zero trust counts
duplicate dispatch and peer-bridge frontends retire after cutover, leaving exactly one production frontend

family_views.first_falsifier: an ambient listener, unauthenticated peer, or unbounded queue surviving alongside the canonical stdio path
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: Backend-neutral convergence production cutover/retirement sequencing remains controlled by #9415 stage I and #7278 deferral rulings; this view freezes the transport/package truth planes only.

family_views.title: Exact evidence and installed/release consumption

compiled_invariants.statement: exact-binary real-session matrices cover initialize/launch/stops, inspection cells, and continue/step/cancel/timeout/restart/zero-leak rows
one command/current receipt executes every mandatory native core row
scorecards are required same-SHA receipts; skipped/missing/stale evidence cannot pass
installed journeys drive the exact packaged binary with artifact identity and cleanup proof
release-cut rulings depend only on earned exact receipts and record deferrals explicitly

family_views.first_falsifier: cross-SHA evidence, repaired-in-place matrix rows, or green checks standing in for receipts
family_views.compilation_boundary_note: No external controller statement applies: the INV-EV invariants are owned inside this family; exact-evidence consumption semantics remain with consumer #10558.
